affectedCopies: DocumentRendition rows of kind preview, written by saveRenderedDocument (apps/web/lib/documents/generation/render-store.ts)
Preview manifest and page PNG bytes stored as content-addressed DocumentBlob rows (apps/web/lib/documents/blob-storage.ts storeDocumentBlob)

privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: not-applicable: a preview is an image of a page of a document the organization already stores. It adds no new personal data; anything a page shows is already in the document's content, under the same Document access scope.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Preview renditions cascade-delete with their DocumentVersion and are served only to a signed-in session, the same access as the document page and its content route. No new retention path is introduced.

migration.name: 20260925140000_document_rendition_preview_kind
migration.backfill: None. The migration only adds the enum member 'preview' and touches no row. Previews exist only for documents the generation facility renders from now on; existing documents keep their pdf and plain_text renditions and show no previews.
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Older code never reads a preview rendition and ignores the extra enum member; the manifest and page blobs remain as ordinary DocumentBlob rows.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Derived projection of a DocumentVersion; cascades with the version. The preview kind is written by the generation facility's store alongside pdf and plain_text.

fields.reason: The closed DocumentRenditionKind enum widens by one member, preview, per AGENTS.md section 8. The rendition's blob is a JSON manifest of page PNG blobs in page order, so the one-rendition-per-kind unique key holds.
